title: K01 BOM / product-data authority policy
principle: A BOM exists even when metadata is incomplete. Metadata HOLD is not equivalent to 'no BOM'.
workflow: read-only BOM extraction from the controlled assembly
reconcile CAD rows with controlled identity/material data
display BOM immediately, including OPEN/HOLD fields
optional controlled metadata projection back to CAD after review
rerun extraction and require zero unexplained delta before PRR
prohibited: hiding the BOM until metadata projection is applied
inventing OPEN material/supplier data merely to remove a HOLD
treating an external spreadsheet as quantity authority when CAD assembly is controlled
